## Implementation checkpoint — 2026-10-10
Plan: a finite three-stage run (outskirts → fortified approach → boss arena), each with explicit wave budget, composition, clear condition and transition screen. Advance only when spawns, hostile units and hostile projectiles are cleared. Carry living player health/loadout; define limited between-stage recovery and fresh ally deployment. Final boss has a dedicated health bar, telegraphed phases, bounded reinforcements and a victory screen. Defeat/restart resets the entire run. Existing map assets/collision geometry must be verified per stage; no unverified boss sprite assumed. Split delivery: stage data/state machine → maps/transitions → boss phases/reward/victory, with lifecycle regression at each step.

title: V2: Add weapon triangle and attack effectiveness rules
body:
Implement Awakening-inspired weapon matchups, distinct from unit-type effectiveness.
Sword beats axe; axe beats lance; lance beats sword. Bows and tomes are neutral in this triangle. Awakening triangle modifies hit and, at higher weapon ranks, attack; decide/document a deterministic adaptation rather than silently importing Fates/Heroes rules.
Bows and wind tomes are effective against flying units. Other effectiveness requires weapon-specific tags (e.g. armor/cavalry/dragon), not blanket magic-vs-armor bonuses. Physical damage checks defense; magical damage checks resistance. Awakening effectiveness triples weapon Might, not final damage.
Acceptance criteria:
- One pure tested damage resolver handles player, enemy and allied attacks consistently.
- Separate weapon family, damage kind, effectiveness tags and defensive stats.
- Show advantage/weakness clearly and test neutral types, opposite matchups, stacked effects and minimum damage.
- Balance against current local stats and record departures from Awakening.
Sources: https://serenesforest.net/awakening/miscellaneous/calculations/ ; https://serenesforest.net/awakening/inventory/bows/ ; https://serenesforest.net/awakening/inventory/tomes/

## Implementation checkpoint — 2026-10-10
Sword/axe/lance triangle, physical Defense/magical Resistance and double final bow damage against flyers are playable documented real-time adaptations. Remaining: shared ally resolver, data-driven effectiveness tags and broader stat/rank handling.

Work remains local until user approves publication.

Awakening standard bows have range 2 and cannot attack adjacent units; Longbow has range 2-3. These are tile rules; our game needs a documented pixel interpretation.
Proposed real-time design: movement sets last facing; Space fires in that direction, with a readable aim line and configurable maximum range. Preserve a close-range weakness, starting with a minimum targeting distance; decide whether already-fired arrows may hit nearer enemies. No hidden automatic melee fallback.
Acceptance criteria:

- Shared player arrow collision, enemy/ally faction rules, expiry, terrain blocking and audio.

title: V2: Add directional blocking and verify guard sprite options
body:
Awakening has chance-based allied Dual Guard that negates a hit; it is not a manual player block button. A manual guard is an intentional real-time adaptation.
Proposed first slice: hold a configurable key to guard the facing arc, reduce physical damage, slow movement and disable attacks; use a bounded guard meter or recovery to prevent indefinite holding. Magic bypasses ordinary guard initially unless a ward is explicitly added. Exact values require playtesting.
Acceptance criteria:
- Define front/back arc, melee/arrow behavior, repeated hits and resource recovery.
- Use a verified guard frame if present; otherwise reuse idle pose with a code-rendered shield arc/impact flash and mark the asset gap. No dedicated guard sheet has been verified from the linked catalog.
- Shared damage handling for guard and weakness interactions.
- Test attack/guard exclusion, rear hits, magic policy, pause/death/restart and input remapping.
- Keep optional NPC-triggered Dual Guard separate from this manual mechanic.
Sources: https://serenesforest.net/awakening/miscellaneous/calculations/ ; https://www.spriters-resource.com/3ds/fireemblemawakening/

title: V2: Implement finite campaign state and stage transitions
body:
First slice of #6. Replace endless wave advancement with typed stage/wave definitions and separate persistent run state. Three proposed stages: Outskirts, Fortified approach, Boss arena. Carry selected hero/health/loadout; offer +25 HP capped at 100 between stages and redeploy two allies. Clear a wave exactly once only when pending spawns, hostiles and hostile projectiles are finished. Explicit Continue screen; menu/death/restart cancels advancement and resets appropriately. Test wave/stage limits, simultaneous clear/death and transient scene cleanup. Local design: docs/stage-progression.md.

## Revised stage-one plan

Stage one revised plan: empty manual deployment of the party and 12 NPC soldiers. Three 16-unit regular waves (48 total) from four known camps. Require hostiles and projectiles cleared, then an 8-second inter-wave warning. Pause/menu must suspend/cancel scheduled releases. Preserve all party progression and loadouts into the next stage. Current local implementation has empty deployment and 48 camp hostiles; staged releases remain the next implementation slice.

## Current local implementation

Implemented locally: Space confirmation and ordered deployment selection, zero active enemies during planning, three 16-unit staggered camp waves, 45-second minimum active-time wave windows, 10-second regroup breaks, 5-second opening muster and 8-second commander warning. Releases use safe fixed camp positions and cap live hostiles at 24. Pausing freezes the phase clock. Victory waits for scheduled releases, enemies and hostile projectiles. Target 3–5 minutes at default damage; full-playthrough pacing review remains needed. Later-stage resupply/carryover remains outstanding.


## Verified final campaign checkpoint
Four authored missions, persistent per-character XP/HP/loadout and treasury, exact loss retry checkpoint and campaign completion integrated.
36 unit checks, production build/typecheck and all50 browser checks pass. Authentic default normal campaign completed12:40.76; all four heroes survived. Local only; no push/deploy.

title: V2: Verify additional map collision layouts and campaign spawns

Four campaign maps are now authored locally through `src/game/data/maps.ts`, with a source-preserving composition script and collision/deployment/spawn metadata:
1. Eastbound bandit road: broad lane, low-level ambushes, follow companions.
2. Village defense: open crossroads and village houses, hold companions.
3. Castle defense: existing open gates/barricades and keep defense.
4. Black Keep: Royal Great Hall layout, central approach, authored wall masks and final commander.

Source credits: WAve plains; ZoramineFae/Flasuban Fort; RandomWizard Royal Great Hall using N426 tiles. No painted/generated world art. Runtime camp and flame replacements are sourced tiles; gold uses Awakening money bag.

High-level MapChunk interface specifies source crop, placement, scale, terrain and entrance sockets, with bounds/ID validation. Actual random generation remains #43 stretch.

Acceptance remaining: integration, full-route player testing, and collision/spawn tuning. Approximately three minutes per mission is a target, not a measured result yet. Local only; not pushed.

title: V2: Add final boss encounter and campaign victory
body:
Third slice of #6, depends on campaign state and verified maps. Commander encounter uses an explicitly documented existing armored placeholder until a verified boss sheet is selected. Named health bar; telegraphed melee/lunge with recovery openings; second phase below 50% adds a Fire spread. At most two once-only reinforcement triggers (75%/40% health) with total hostile cap 30. Shared faction/damage rules apply. Victory requires boss and remaining hostiles/projectiles cleared. Test phase threshold crossings, boss death during windup, simultaneous player death, victory and replay cleanup. Boss identity/art and tuned values remain review decisions.

## Revised stage-one plan

Stage one now culminates in an Outskirts Commander after its three regular waves, in addition to a later campaign-final boss. Initial tuning: 1,200 HP, Defense 8, Resistance 5, slow telegraphed melee with recovery openings. At 75% and 40% HP, each once, summon six level-3 elites (two knights, two mages, two axemen), 1.5x class HP and 1.25x base damage. Cap 24 hostiles including reinforcements; safe reachable spawns must avoid allied units. Require boss, minions and hostile projectiles cleared for victory. Named commander art needs verification/import; use a labeled existing armored placeholder initially. Validate simultaneous threshold crossings, boss death before reinforcements, pause/menu and replay cleanup. This schedule is planned, not implemented yet.

## Current local implementation

Stage-one commander implemented locally with verified generic heavy sprite, 3,600 HP, slow 950ms telegraph and 850ms recovery, Defense 8/Resistance 5. One-time elite squads trigger at 75% and 40% HP, each with two knights, two mages and two axemen; level 3, 1.5x health, 1.25x damage and scaled XP. Releases are staggered and bounded by the global 24-hostile cap. Boss HUD shows remaining HP. Named villain art and the later campaign-final encounter remain outstanding.


## Verified final campaign checkpoint
Castle/final commanders900/1400HP, two three-unit reinforcement thresholds, old wave survivors withdraw on arrival, commander death determines victory. Normal-speed final defeat still requires observed proof.
36 unit checks, production build/typecheck and all50 browser checks pass. Authentic default normal campaign completed12:40.76; all four heroes survived. Local only; no push/deploy.
